Dynamic intro thresholds, previous answer/link and historical nearest routes; today/yesterday have spoiler warnings. server.mjs serves daily/puzzle APIs and arbitrary valid historical/current scoring with bounds, timeouts, response validation, short daily cache keyed by Korean date, bounded snapshot cache. README documents; browser test script follows current puzzle. npm test:13 pass incl mounted game midnight rollover with delayed prior score, preference/history preservation, server action, preview expiry. npm run build passes.
